<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44193.

The existing Hopper CUDA Graph replay test was written for the legacy paged
`select_decode` path. Its fixture and assertions intentionally cover that
path's contract, including sorted page indices and fully reset output padding.

After `FullTopKIndexer` gained the DeepSelect decode dispatch, pinning the
legacy test to `use_deep_select_decode = False` preserved its original
coverage, but left the `FullTopKIndexer -> DeepSelect` integration path without
CUDA Graph capture/replay coverage. This PR closes that gap with a dedicated
test while keeping the legacy contract test unchanged in scope.

## Modifications

- Keep `test_hopper_indexer_backends_replay` on the legacy `select_decode`
  path and clarify its purpose in the test comment.
- Add `test_hopper_deep_select_full_topk_replay` for Hopper, parameterized over
  compression ratios 1 and 2.
- Build production-shaped paged metadata with `page_table`,
  `compressed_page_size`, and a page-aligned score capacity of 32768 entries
  so the DeepSelect row stride satisfies its 128-byte alignment requirement.
- Capture the DeepSelect path in a CUDA Graph, then replay it while changing
  query values, sequence lengths, request rows, and page-table mappings.
- Exercise empty and short sequences, the `topk=512` boundary
  (`511/512/513`), and `width=1025` so both the short-sequence shortcut and the
  real score-based Top-K path are covered.
- Validate DeepSelect's unordered Top-K contract by comparing selected score
  multisets, and verify that unused entries within each active output row are
  reset to `-1` after the output is poisoned before replay.

## Accuracy Tests

This is a test-only change and does not modify model or kernel outputs.

Validated on an NVIDIA H20 (SM90):

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 -m pytest \
  registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_fp4_indexer.py \
  -k hopper_deep_select_full_topk_replay -vv -s
```

```text
test_hopper_deep_select_full_topk_replay[1] PASSED
test_hopper_deep_select_full_topk_replay[2] PASSED
2 passed, 135 deselected
```

Static checks also pass:

```text
python3 -m py_compile test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_fp4_indexer.py
python3 -m ruff check test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_fp4_indexer.py
All checks passed!
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. This PR only adds and scopes unit tests; no production code or
inference path is changed.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A: test-only change)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A: no production-code impact)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -633,8 +633,8 @@ def test_hopper_indexer_backends_replay(ratio):
         token_to_kv_pool=pool, req_to_token=req_table, use_deep_gemm_prefill=False
     )
     full = FullTopKIndexer(**kwargs, use_deep_gemm_decode=False)
-    # This replay test checks the paged select_decode output contract; DeepSelect
-    # decode is covered by test_deep_select.py.
+    # This replay test pins the select_decode contract (sorted picks); the
+    # DeepSelect replay contract lives in test_hopper_deep_select_full_topk_replay.
     full.use_deep_select_decode = False
     candidates = DenseBlocksBackend(
         **kwargs, candidate_topk_blocks=4, candidate_block_size=8
@@ -750,6 +750,111 @@ def run():
                 assert (out.raw_indices[batch] == -1).all().item()
 
 
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] != 9,
+    reason="Hopper DeepSelect full-topk dispatch",
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ratio", [1, 2])
+def test_hopper_deep_select_full_topk_replay(ratio):
+    from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4.v41_indexer.full_topk import FullTopKIndexer
+    from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4.v41_indexer.types import DecodeInputs
+
+    batch, width, topk = 12, 1025, 512
+    # DeepSelect rejects score rows whose byte stride is not a multiple of 128
+    # (entry.cuh); production keeps lmax page-granular through the
+    # max_compressed_seq_len property, so the mock's capacity must be too.
+    num_pages = 512
+    capacity = num_pages * PAGE_SIZE
+    q, weights, slots, lens, table = _make_logits_case(batch, 32, width)
+    req = torch.arange(batch, device=q.device, dtype=torch.int32) // 6
+    request_pages = (slots[::6, ::PAGE_SIZE] // PAGE_SIZE).to(torch.int32)
+    logical = torch.arange(width, device=q.device)
+    page_columns, page_offsets = logical // PAGE_SIZE, logical % PAGE_SIZE
+    req_table = torch.full(
+        (2, capacity * ratio), -1, device=q.device, dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    page_table = torch.full((batch, num_pages), -1, device=q.device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    positions = lens * ratio - 1
+
+    def update_tables(step):
+        pages = request_pages.roll(step, dims=1)
+        request_slots = (pages[:, page_columns] * PAGE_SIZE + page_offsets).contiguous()
+        req_table[:, : width * ratio : ratio].copy_(
+            (request_slots * ratio).to(torch.int32)
+        )
+        page_table.fill_(-1)
+        page_table[:, : pages.shape[1]].copy_(pages[req.long()])
+        return request_slots[req.long()]
+
+    current_slots = update_tables(0)
+    pool = SimpleNamespace(get_index_k_with_scale_buffer=lambda layer: table)
+    indexer = SimpleNamespace(
+        queries=lambda q, freqs: q, head_weights=lambda x: x, index_topk=topk
+    )
+    metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+        max_compressed_seq_len=capacity,
+        page_table=page_table,
+        compressed_page_size=PAGE_SIZE,
+    )
+    output = torch.full((batch, topk), -1, device=q.device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    inputs = DecodeInputs(
+        indexer=indexer,
+        layer_id=0,
+        compress_ratio=ratio,
+        freqs_cis=torch.zeros(width * ratio + 1, device=q.device),
+        x=weights,
+        q_lora=q,
+        positions=positions,
+        req_rows=req,
+        paged_metadata=metadata,
+        is_verify=True,
+        out_page_indices=output,
+    )
+    full = FullTopKIndexer(
+        token_to_kv_pool=pool,
+        req_to_token=req_table,
+        use_deep_gemm_prefill=False,
+        use_deep_gemm_decode=False,
+    )
+    assert full.use_deep_select_decode
+
+    def run():
+        full.topk_decode(inputs)
+
+    for _ in range(3):
+        run()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        run()
+
+    for step, visible in enumerate([1025, 0, 1, 511, 512, 513, 1025]):
+        lens.copy_((visible - torch.arange(batch, device=q.device) % 6).clamp_min(0))
+        positions.copy_(lens * ratio - 1)
+        req.copy_(req.roll(1))
+        current_slots = update_tables(step)
+        q.neg_()
+        output.fill_(12345)
+        graph.replay()
+
+        scores = _reference_logits(q, weights, current_slots, lens, table)
+        for row, length in enumerate(lens.tolist()):
+            count = min(topk, length)
+            pages = output[row]
+            assert (pages[:count] >= 0).all().item()
+            assert (pages[count:] == -1).all().item()
+            selected = (
+                current_slots[row, :, None] == pages[:count].long()[None, :]
+            ).nonzero()[:, 0]
+            assert selected.numel() == selected.unique().numel() == count
+            if count:
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    scores[row, selected].sort().values,
+                    scores[row, :length].topk(count).values.sort().values,
+                    rtol=0,
+                    atol=0,
+                )
+
+
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [0, 1, 32, 129])
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("topk", [0, 1, 65, 512])
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("write_raw", [False, True])
